42481f97c7 (0 behind main; check-ci-fast + test-touched + check-ci-compile green).
1 main_worktree_root_from identical to main; resolve_default_branch_ref unchanged; show-only _until returns a distinct Timeout, rendered as unknown (kept #2635's explicit unknown token, not line omission). Caller list in the PR body: only show/linkage callers get a deadline.

3 Nested-.git skip in trace.rs reverted with its test.
4 AC1 bisect 97453570d6..95f15a20d4: no regression (335 vs 355 / 431.5 vs 450.5 ms). Main is 2.1x slower than 95f15a20d4: 242 commits, filed BUG-2192.
5 Weak tests replaced by 4 slow-git shim tests, mutation-checked.
Extra: bounded-command poll backs off 1 to 20 ms (was a flat 20 ms).
Medians, 3 runs each: load 6.5 piped main 494.6 / PR 537.1 (pre poll fix); load 5.3 piped 910.8 / 993.6; json 3360.0/3302.1 and 4126.1/3794.2. Phase check: linkage is level with main (266-317 vs 271-342 ms); the piped gap is host noise.
